jpeg-decoder.cjs is lib/decoder.js of jpeg-js 0.4.4 (npm, BSD-3-Clause for jpeg-js, Apache-2.0 for the pdf.js decoder it is based on; the header of the file keeps the Apache notice, jpeg-js.LICENSE is the jpeg-js licence). Copied unchanged except for the file name (the tool is ES modules, so it is .cjs). Only the decoder is used (scripts/image/jpeg.mjs): Flow downloads are JPEG and the sparkle remover reads RGBA pixels. Not an npm dependency of the tool.
